notes.text: Record in the PAESE joint database. It identifies the Roemer- und Pelizaeus-Museum Hildesheim as the location. The page labels the object Hoheitszeichen ("Langkeule") and ua; the latter corresponds to the IndiGen description Ua. The English interface labels display German source values. Although the page displays object photographs, it states no image-reuse permission, so no image is included. The project notes that images may be withheld in other cases for ethical or legal reasons.

captures.note: Reviewed default Basic Information tab; other record tabs were not included.
